The annual '''Cargo Track 3000''' was the only legal [[Cargo Track race]] in the city of [[Bartyn's Landing]], in [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]]. [[Swoop/Legends|Swoop]] racers had a to race through a dangerous, unpredictable and automated race. Bets were accepted. In about [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]], one of the participants planned to cheat at the Cargo Track 3000.
